pack_b.clean_start: Structurally pristine — single-object format, independent authoring
pack_b.pattern: Prerequisite defect fixes (DL-017/DL-024) → batch certification waves → full closure

pack_e.clean_start: Structurally clean — single-object format, different authorship pipeline
pack_e.pattern: Higher distractor similarity (DL-005) but fewer structural defects → similar velocity to Pack B

key_differences: Dual-object format (Packs A/C/D) vs single-object (Packs B/E) slows remediation
DL-008 CC-rotation in Pack C is unique — no precedent in completed packs
DL-012 clone groups in Packs C/D Section E — Pack B had rotation artifacts but not clone groups
Higher defect density in remaining sections: DL-013 (851 fields) vs Pack B's DL-017 (275 sites)
remaining_packs.velocity_adjustment: Estimate 60-70% of Pack B velocity for remaining items due to higher defect density and dual-object format complexity

phases.label: Quick Wins — Pack A Closeout + Small Clears
phases.target: Pack A Sections A+E (19 items) + Pack D DL-008 mechanical (10 items)
phases.expected_outcome: Pack A reaches 500/500 Certified. Pack D learner pool DL-008 exposure resolved.

phases.label: Large Block Remediation — Unprocessed Sections
phases.target: Pack C Section F (75) + Pack D Section F (74)
phases.expected_outcome: Two largest unprocessed blocks → certified. Portfolio certified count reaches 2,330.

phases.label: DL-008 Cluster Remediation — Pack C CC Audit
phases.target: Pack C Sections A/B 174-item DL-008 cluster
phases.dependency: DL-008 remediation experience from Phase 2. CC audit is prerequisite.
phases.expected_outcome: All 174 Pack C items cleared of DL-008. CC verified correct. Portfolio certified count unchanged (items already Certified) but learner pool safety improved.

phases.label: Clone Group Audit — Section E Remediation
phases.target: Pack C Section E (56 clones + 19 unprocessed) + Pack D Section E (56 clones + 19 unprocessed)
phases.dependency: DL-008 resolution frees capacity for clone-group review
phases.expected_outcome: Final sections certified. Portfolio reaches 2,500/2,500 Certified.

confidence: Medium — calibrated against 2 complete packs (1,000 items). Remaining 319 items have higher defect density and structural complexity (dual-object format) not present in calibration data. Actual session count may be 12-18 depending on CC-rotation severity in Pack C and DL-016 scope in Pack A.
model_limitations: Assumes defect density in unprocessed sections is similar to processed sections (may be higher — these sections were left for last)
Does not account for DL-016 offset scope — if full Pack A is affected, remediation effort increases
CC-rotation artifact in Pack C is uncalibrated — no precedent in completed packs
Concurrent-write risk (DL-019) adds process overhead not in model
